the molecular mechanisms that underlie the light-adaptive dispersion of melanin pigment granule into apical projections in retinal pigment cells.
the mechanisms by which fish retinal pigment epithelial (RPE) cells migrate pigment granules to reduce light damage.

carbachol-induced pigment dispersion in isolated retinas occurs through the activation Modd muscarin receptors, which are Gq-coupled and activate phospholipase C.

muscarinic receptors are involved in the regulation of retinal pigment granule migration in bluegill.
the cholinergic system plays a significant role in the light-adaptive responses of the retina.
